name: Literature Review
description: Search, extract, and synthesize research papers on a specified topic. Engine-assisted search and extraction with human review at the end.

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: The research topic to review (e.g., 'CRISPR gene editing', 'transformer architectures').

parameters.name: maxPapers
parameters.description: Maximum number of papers to include in the review.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Primary focus area for the review.

taskTemplates.title: Search for papers on {{topic}}
taskTemplates.description: Find up to {{maxPapers}} relevant papers using Bookshelf search and external databases.

taskTemplates.title: Extract key findings from papers
taskTemplates.description: For each paper, extract: main claims, methodology, key results, and limitations.
acceptanceCriteria: Each paper has a structured summary

taskTemplates.title: Identify contradictions and gaps
taskTemplates.description: Cross-reference findings to identify contradictory claims, methodological disagreements, and research gaps.

taskTemplates.title: Draft synthesis on {{topic}}
taskTemplates.description: Write a cohesive synthesis document covering the state of the art, focusing on {{focus}}.

taskTemplates.title: Human review and finalize
taskTemplates.description: Expert reviews the synthesis for accuracy, completeness, and scientific rigor. Makes final edits.
